title: Ascendance of a Bookworm ~I'll do anything to become a librarian!~ Part 1 If there aren't any books, I'll just have make some!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A Japanese college student who loves books dies in an earthquake and wakes as Myne, the sickly five-year-old daughter of a poor soldier, in a medieval-style world where books are costly luxuries for nobles. Using memories of modern life, she improves hygiene at home, learns letters from her father's colleague Otto and sets out to make paper and books herself. This manga covers Part 1 of the novels.
life_message: Determination, ingenuity and love of learning can lift a child out of hardship, with family support.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Preparing for winter in poverty while pursuing a personal dream.

folkways.japan: Myne's modern Japanese habits, like daily bathing and hair washing, startle her medieval-style family.
